), America's grocer, is welcoming fall with the launch of its limited-time Private Selection™ Pumpkin Harvest Collection, a seasonal lineup crafted to bring all the comforting flavors of autumn to every part of the day. The collection will be exclusively available across the Kroger Co. Family of Stores.*

"That first crisp morning is the best sign that fall has officially arrived, welcoming in the warm flavors and spices that make this season so special," said Ann Reed, Group Vice President of Our Brands at Kroger. "Our new Private Selection Pumpkin Harvest Collection was crafted to help customers embrace the season with flavors that make every coffee break, afternoon snack and sweet seasonal treat even more memorable."
The collection offers new ways to enjoy pumpkin across beverages, snacks, bakery favorites and more.
Every fall beverage is better with these pumpkin-flavored sips that bring a taste of the season to life:
Pumpkin Spice Gourmet Ground Coffee and Coffee Pods:
Smooth coffee infused with pumpkin, cinnamon and nutmeg
A blend of cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger and clove flavors that adds a seasonal twist to any favorite beverage
Pumpkin Spice Flavored Chai Black Tea:
Black tea blended with pumpkin flavor and warming spices for a satisfying seasonal sip
Snack your way through the season with these sweet, salty and satisfyingly crunchy bites:
Crunchy popcorn glazed with pumpkin spice and finished with a sweet icing drizzle
Kettle-cooked cashews coated in sugar and aromatic allspice
Crunchy, snackable granola clusters inspired by the rich flavors of pumpkin cheesecake
Indulge in the sweeter side of autumn with these freshly baked pumpkin treats:
Soft muffins crafted with real pumpkin and seasonal spices, topped with streusel and sparkling sugar – and even better warmed up
Rich pumpkin blondie bites finished with cream cheese icing, pecans and butterscotch chips
Buttery shortbread with warm pumpkin spice for a crisp, melt-in-your-mouth bite
